data.name: Sinu
data.gender_notes: Sinu is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sinu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sita', which means 'Moon'. It is also derived from the Tamil and Telugu word 'Sinu', which means 'Sinuous'. This name is associated with the calmness, gentleness and flexibility of the moon and its sinuous movements. The name Sinu carries the meaning “Moon, Sinuous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Telugu. Parents who choose Sinu usually hope their child will grow to embody moon, sinuous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sinu is a symbol of the divine feminine energy and represents the nurturing, calming and healing aspects of the universe. It is believed to bring peace, harmony and balance to the mind, body and soul.
data.etymology: Sinu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon, Sinuous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sinu total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
